who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of track 4b task C, int-1112
what: The daemon's body entries mapped the syntax to the database by a body's name and inline modules (entries::bodies, def_of), so every `impl` and trait body was passed over, the borrow check was refused by the world, and a closure's MIR had no entry: most of reth's 12,234 `evicted_asked` inference runs were bodies no entry could ever serve. The keep also ran before fallible store() work, so a claim could be marked for puts that never reached the loop.
cost: the body edit under dependents on reth at 58-77 s; one plan and three executors to undo
cause: a map from syntax to database chosen by what was easy to name (a path), not by what both sides share (where the body is written and what kind it is)
class: an identity joined through a derived name that only part of the domain has
prevention: join two views of one thing on a field both own (file, start, kind); count every row either side has that the join leaves out, by why
fix: front_carry::bodies keys by entries::keyed/written/join, serves and keeps inference, every MIR owner and the borrow check, counts in_macros/unmapped/unkeyed/refused, and keep_bodies is the last statement of store(). Controls: BODY_ONLY and BLIND in serve::unit::tests.
